hook_text: Everything from gears to the grid to the panic button fits on one folded sheet. Here is the fast version before the paper.
clip_script: Circuits: symbols, dots, series shares, parallel survives, polarity for cells and LEDs. Energy: six options, five criteria, cheap is dangerous; illegal wires lack every protection; balanced report, both sides. Cells: series volts, parallel hours. Solar: half a volt a cell. Stations: heat, steam, turbine, generator; coal, gas, nuclear, solar thermal; hydro, pumped storage, wind. Grid: AC, transformers, 50 hertz. Ohm: volts push, amps flow, ohms squeeze. AND series, OR parallel, tables in binary. Panic button: brief, specs, three parallel switches, eight rows, honest poster. Gears: opposite ways, driven over driver. Exam: command word, reason, both sides, working, dots and rows.
visual_style: Whiteboard folded sheet flipping between a circuit side and a gear side; icons flash past for each topic; a command word gets underlined; a checklist ticks off dots and rows.
pacing: Term 4 in two sweeps, Term 3 in one, exam craft.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write your own one-page summary of each term from memory.
